job.question: What is the proposal submission deadline in the Oklahoma Public Employees Retirement System (OPERS) investment consulting services RFP?
job.acceptance: Accept Central Time/CT; explicit equivalent timezone conversion acceptable.

reviews.reason: The document is an Illinois Municipal Retirement Fund (IMRF) sample RFP, not the Oklahoma Public Employees Retirement System (OPERS) RFP. Its submission deadline is a placeholder and does not support the requested date or time.
